scope: Read-only concrete next-cohort design. No new code, lemma, proof, compilation, producer invocation, saved input, controller, mathematical source assumption, external/child agent, commit or push.
context: Reused actual source/provider memory and own SafeEnclosure/RationalBudget authorship; fresh file inspection of the actual compiler/export/replay chain. Not fresh whole-chain independence or scientific review.
scientific_conventions: Original normalized signed Hermite samples unchanged; physical q0 is LSB. No phase quotient, postselection, discarded terminal garbage or source replacement.

actual_routes.limitations: This OffsetSource path exists as a finite diagnostic. The new QR residual wrapper is not wired into it; adding a separate trace consumer must retain the identical returned D object/bytes. The test's expected source vector is diagnostic, not constructor input.
This frozen transport generator uses the older stable source, NOT OffsetSource or the scaled-return QRResidual entry. Its saved fixtures cannot automatically be relabeled as the new source/QR packet.

actual_routes.route: qiskit_circuit consumes plan.gates binary64 angles; write_qasm2 at152 regenerates same iterator and prints angles with .17g
actual_routes.limitations: Saved decimal semantics, parsed binary64 semantics and original binary64 angle semantics are distinct targets; hash and bind the same actual plan/chronology.

escape_points.finding: QRResidual only certifies the same scaled_right_canonicalize output D and its literal ScaledNorm against normalized stored raw C. It has no compiler/saved-action consumer.

compile_mps(D) calls right_canonicalize(prune_zero_paths(D)); it does not preserve D's cores. Exact stored-zero pruning preserves zero paths only by an unproved code-level adapter; repeated QR/absorption/head normalization creates a new stored E.

The repeated right_canonicalize uses NumPy reduced QR, einsum absorption, ordinary float norm and head division, not the scaled producer. MPSPlan.norm is this new computed float, not the already-certified ScaledNorm.

complete_isometry pads each E core to 2B, checks approximate isometry, obtains a complete QR complement, overwrites prescribed columns and may flip determinant sign. Tolerance checks are not exact orthogonality or core-action certificates; completed U is not stored in MPSPlan.

adjacent_gray_elimination performs rounded hypot/division/row updates and atan2, then reverses rotation order. Its float residual measures elimination-to-identity, not saved primitive action error. MPSPlan.max_completion_error actually aggregates these elimination residuals, not a complete global completion/error proof.

expand_edge_rotation applies floating sign/scaling to angles and Gray/Walsh RY/CX expansion. gates at131 maps local data highest and low bond bits to global data n-1-offset and ancillas n..n+a-1. Exact backend identities do not by themselves refine this floating implementation.

write_qasm2 prints real angle tokens .17g. Existing auditor distinguishes exact decimals from actual binary64 reference and records transport bounds, but supplies no full state or Python-to-Lean parser/primitive bridge.

minimal_next_cohort.objective: Construct an exact-rational surrogate TT of the FULL action of the SAME saved RY/CX list, then separately certify its distance to that saved mathematical quantum action and to E(D), with E(D) the literal signed scaled-return D padded by zero ancillas.
minimal_next_cohort.first_case: n=3,k=1,L=Fraction(1). Obtain actual OffsetSource raw C, one certified scaled return D,s, then one unmodified compile_mps(D) plan and actual saved bytes. This is a proposed NEW tiny fixture; do not claim older stable-source transport fixtures already follow this route.
minimal_next_cohort.bounded_budget: First n<=3, bond B<=16, <=50000 saved primitives, fixed explicit rational trig enclosure/refinement and text/input limits. Report LIMIT_REACHED/IMPLEMENTATION_FAILED if exceeded. These experiment caps are not source-family restrictions or mathematical impossibility.
minimal_next_cohort.trace_only: In a future new experimental wrapper, record core bytes/shape hashes for C and D and the exact frozen call return; capture compile_mps's pruning/repeated-QR E, per-stage completed float matrices and plane lists using observer wrappers that forward unchanged calls/returns. Diagnostic trace is optional provenance and localization, not a new compiler, free matrix oracle or trusted ideal action.
minimum_checks: Exact byte/plan identity and chronological gate ranges for all n stages, including empty stages.
QASM type/wire/order validation against actual source manifest; reject reused-data stages, cross-stage wires, missing/extra instructions and malformed tokens.
Reference data is D, not freshly normalized D, reconstructed E, independent dense source samples or a phase-aligned vector.
Retain every final bond label, including padded/unreachable labels; no threshold pruning or zero-garbage assertion.
Own small dense replay only as diagnostic; primary checker input is local stage matrix/enclosure and TT cores, never 2^n amplitudes.

Adversaries: one angle/sign/wire/order change, a final ancilla X implemented in RY/CX if desired, active-bond-only truncation, zero/deficient/tall core, empty stage and parser decimal/binary64 mismatch. A valid large residual is not an accuracy-success verdict.

proposed_interfaces.name: SavedStageWord
proposed_interfaces.type: {n:Nat>=1,a:Nat,B=2^a; saved_bytes:bytes; gate_stream:list(RY(theta:Rat,wire:Fin(n+a)) | CX(control,target:Fin(n+a))); stage_spans:Vector n (start,count); byte_hash; manifest_hash}
proposed_interfaces.contract: Choose exact textual decimal theta for the primary saved semantics. Validate actual bytes and full chronological partition. Stage i touches only ancillas n..n+a-1 and fresh data n-1-i, with no later reuse of that data. Spans come from the SAME actual plan, including empty stages, and are independently checked; a manifest is provenance, not a primitive-action theorem.

proposed_interfaces.name: FiniteTrigStageEnclosure
proposed_interfaces.type: (SavedStageWord, explicit rational precision/refinement budget) -> Result(Vector n MatrixEnclosure(Fin(2B),Fin(2B),Rat) | diagnostic_failure)
proposed_interfaces.contract: Produce sound rational sin(theta/2),cos(theta/2) intervals by a concrete finite algorithm, then compose actual local RY/CX matrices in saved order. This supplier and its mathematical soundness remain to be implemented/proved; do not assume a free exact-real evaluator. Explicit finite theta/range/text caps may fail honestly.

proposed_interfaces.name: RationalStageSurrogate
proposed_interfaces.type: For each stage i: center Uhat_i:Matrix(Fin(2B),Fin(2B),Rat), entry_error delta_i:Rat>=0, eta_i=(2B)*delta_i
proposed_interfaces.contract: Center is selected deterministically from rational matrix intervals. If all entries of the true stage action lie within delta_i, Frobenius/operator error <=(2B)*delta_i is a proposed derivation, not a supplied success assumption. Completed float U_i may be decoded exactly for separate localization but MUST NOT be treated as the true saved action.

proposed_interfaces.name: FullTerminalActionChain
proposed_interfaces.type: (Vector n Uhat_i, B=2^a) -> validated rational core chain of n+a physical bits, scalar boundaries
proposed_interfaces.contract: For each stage, K_i[incoming,bit,outgoing]=Uhat_i[bit*B+outgoing,incoming], i.e. the input data bit is fresh zero. Initial incoming bond is 0; all subsequent bonds have full size B. Keep the last outgoing B label and append a deterministic a-bit readout chain, NOT projection onto terminal label0.

proposed_interfaces.name: LiteralReturnedTTEmbedding
proposed_interfaces.type: actual D float64 TT -> exact rational Dhat + a zero-ancilla product cores -> scalar-boundary chain n+a
proposed_interfaces.contract: Decode actual D exactly. Embed E(D)(j,b)=D(j) if b=0 and 0 otherwise, without renormalizing D or discarding residual source/canonicalization error. A mechanically proved decoder still remains a separate missing interface.

proposed_interfaces.name: FullSavedActionResidualPacket
proposed_interfaces.type: {hashes, dimensions, stage_spans, rational chains Qhat,E(D), exact G_Qhat,G_D,cross,q, directed r, stage eta, sigma, measured work} -> diagnostic/certificate candidate
proposed_interfaces.contract: Compute q=G_Qhat+G_D-2*cross and directed r^2>=q. Reuse QRResidual.residual_identity with s=1 for literal pair distance; DO NOT call certificate_to_normalized in a way that silently replaces D by normalize(D). Three cross-Gram passes apply to scalar-boundary appended chains. Ordinary certify_pair currently requires float64 input and normalizes its raw target, so it is not the desired drop-in consumer for rational surrogate versus literal D.

full_garbage_topology.coordinate_map: Core words are ordered data n-1..0 first, then ancilla a-1..0 readout. Explicit bijection phi(word)=(j,b) maps to physical full-register integer j+2^n*b. This differs from a naive global-MSB-first TT listing and must be proved/checked; both compared chains use the same bijection.
full_garbage_topology.terminal_readout: A rational delta routing chain emits the MSB of b at each readout step and carries the remaining low bits, with bonds B,B/2,...,1. For a=0 this is the empty tail. It preserves all B terminal sectors exactly.
full_garbage_topology.full_residual: Sum over every data word AND every final ancilla word of (Qhat(j,b)-E(D)(j,b))^2. Cross-Gram over n+a sites captures garbage and signed target mismatch jointly. It is neither postselection nor a zero-garbage-only overlap.
full_garbage_topology.stage_semantics_gap: Need an actual local-saved-gate-to-matrix and stage-to-sequential-chain refinement. Chronological fresh-data access is the compactness condition. If it fails, reject this specialized compact adapter; generic circuit contraction may have exponential width.

prospective_error_accounting.stage_surrogate: The proposed true stage U_i is unitary under exact RY/CX semantics. Uhat_i need not be unitary: ||Uhat_i||<=1+eta_i. A conservative telescope gives sigma=product_i(1+eta_i)-1 for ||actual_saved_state-Qhat||. Do not use sum eta_i with unproved unitary surrogate factors. This inequality and producer enclosure soundness are future proof work, not current assumptions added to the scientific source.
prospective_error_accounting.literal_target: Then ||actual_saved_state-E(D)||<=sigma+r, where r bounds exact full rational pair residual.
prospective_error_accounting.stored_raw: If the SAME D already has QRResidual rho=r_QR+tau_QR against normalize(C), triangle composition can add rho. The target remains literal signed normalized stored C, not ideal Hermite.
prospective_error_accounting.source_gap: To reach scientific Hermite target still need an independently supplied ideal-source-to-stored-C bound and source norm floor, plus decoder/parser/primitive refinement and total finite-data cost. None is closed by this design.
prospective_error_accounting.parser_alternative: If choosing actual parser's binary64 angles instead of exact decimal semantics, bind that parser interpretation explicitly and add the separately measured decimal/binary64 RY perturbation budget; do not mix semantics or advertise .17g byte transport as strict exact angle identity.

work_model.stage_storage: Only local 2B by2B matrices and O(nB^2) rational cores plus terminal readout. No 2^n amplitude input/output table. Completed floating matrices are diagnostics, not free arbitrary unitaries.
work_model.stage_cost: A future primitive row-pair/permutation implementation can charge O(G*(2B)^2) rational interval operations for G primitives; generic dense multiplication would instead charge O(G*(2B)^3). Record the actually implemented schedule. These are design models, not proved current runtime/optimization claims.
work_model.cross_gram: With T=n+a and M=max(B, actual D max bond,1), the existing declared three-pass model is <=27*T*M^3 rational additions/multiplications after rational-chain embedding. The current Python interpreter bridge and rational-chain validation remain required.
work_model.finite_bit: Charge rational decoding, interval endpoint numerator/denominator growth, trig range reduction/Taylor or equivalent steps, shifts, GCD/division, sqrt rounding, allocations, output text, stage matrices and QR separately. Measure operand/intermediate bits; no uniform polynomial bit/runtime theorem is inferred.
work_model.not_accepted: No lower bound, optimality, all-k success, arbitrary-epsilon float64 success, ROOT or publication claim.

potential_failures: Repeated legacy QR may overflow/underflow or change the returned TT beyond desired tolerance; record the exact failure.
Approximate completion/determinant/Gray elimination checks may fail; max_completion_error alone is not a state certificate.
Stage interval dependency growth may be wide; midpoint surrogates can be nonunitary and amplify errors.
Saved instruction grouping, bit endian or ancilla readout mistakes can falsely omit terminal garbage.
Large residual/certificate cap, missing sound trig producer, decoder or parser bridge must remain SOURCE_GAP rather than conditional scientific success.
Ideal OffsetSource errors, fixed cutoff cap and float polynomial/exponential errors remain upstream even if saved action matches stored D tightly.

handoff.recommended_priority: Seal a narrow stage-chronology/full-terminal-readout interface first, then tiny actual OffsetSource n3k1L1 saved-action diagnostic with exact rational surrogate residual. Sound finite trig interval generation/refinement is the first substantive producer-proof boundary; do not silently assume it.
